Written at `library/domains/engineering/domains/tech/domains/computing/texts/guix-guile-composition-layer.md`. Draft survey covering:

- **System as value** -- the core architectural idea, with Scheme code examples
- **Service extension graph** -- how services compose via a DAG rather than sequential ordering
- **Guile features** -- records, hygienic macros, store monad, G-expressions, modules
- **Nix comparison** -- shared foundation, language divergence, ecosystem gap
- **Bootstrap** -- full-source bootstrap and supply-chain integrity
- **Limitations** -- learning curve, ecosystem size, composition complexity
- **Design thesis** -- when a full programming language as configuration layer matters vs. when simpler tools suffice

Six sources cited. Cross-links to existing terms (infrastructure-as-code, composition).
